class.name: MIDIEventSystem
class.description:
MIDIEventSystem represents a MIDI system message, including system common messages, system real-time messages, and system-exclusive messages.
The event_type property identifies the system message using its MIDI status byte. System messages are not associated with a specific MIDI channel, so the inherited channel property is initialized to 0.
The event's consumed byte count is tracked internally when the event is constructed from raw MIDI data.

members.member: The MIDI system message type, represented by its status byte.

constants.constant: Song position pointer message, indicating a position within a MIDI song.
Start message, requesting playback to begin.
Continue message, requesting playback to resume.
Active sensing message, used to monitor the continued presence of a MIDI connection.
